description: Use this when the user wants to see or cook one specific recipe: its ingredients, steps, times and photo. Pass servings to scale every ingredient quantity. Takes an id or slug from another tool's results; for a pasted link use import_recipe. Without a linked account the recipe comes from the public recipe page's data: a few internal columns (video ids, short title, SEO title, bookmark/favorite/collection counts, site, cuisine and restaurant refs) come back null.

identifier.description: The recipe slug or ID (IDs start with 'rec_')

servings.description: Scale the ingredients to this many servings. Leave out for the recipe as written.

name: get_recipe
title: Get a recipe
